'''Pattapu''' ({{ipa|ptq|pɐʈːɐpu|ipa}}) is a described [[Dravidian language]] of [[Andhra Pradesh]].<ref name="isoreq">{{cite Q|Q130343748|language=English,Pattapu}}</ref> 
 
Pattapu is spoken by a coastal community in Southern Andhra Pradesh, India. They are listed as an [[Other Backward Class]].

They mostly live in the coastal areas of [[Nellore district|Nellore]], [[Prakasam district|Prakasam]] and [[Bapatla district]]s. The people that speak the language belong to 146 different villages. The language is closely related to [[Tamil language|Tamil]] but also has influences of [[Telugu language|Telugu]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sakshi.com/telugu-news/bapatla/1601474|title='పట్టపు' భాష మాది! | - | Sakshi|language=te|trans-title=The language of 'Pattapu' is ours|website=[[Sakshi (newspaper)|Sakshi]]}}</ref>

Most of their villages have a temple dedicated to [[Rama|Lord Sriram]].

According to Ramayana: one person from this caste was helped by [[Rama|Lord Sriram]] to cross the river in search of [[Sita|Ma Site Devi]]. Lord Sriram promised that person that he will be worshipped by that person's caste (pattapu kapu).<ref>{{Cite web |title=అనగనగా ఒక ఊరు.. అందరిదీ ఒకేమాట {{!}} Pedda Pattapu Palem All Sarpanches Were Unanimously Elected {{!}} Sakshi |url=https://www.sakshi.com/telugu-news/andhra-pradesh/pedda-pattapu-palem-all-sarpanches-were-unanimously-elected-1340588 |access-date=2024-12-25 |website=www.sakshi.com |language=te}}</ref>

They are mostly dependent on hunting, fishing and agriculture.
